evaluations.claim: The outermost bars in the 'Bottleneck' distribution are approximately 50% taller than the central ones.
evaluations.reality: The outermost bars in the 'Bottleneck' distribution are only slightly taller than the central ones, not by 50%.

evaluations.claim: The 'Spindle' distribution has the highest overall average bar height among all categories, exceeding the 'Increasing' distribution by roughly 20% on average.
evaluations.reality: The 'Spindle' distribution does not have the highest average bar height; the 'Increasing' distribution has taller bars overall.
